name: Ob Nixilis Reignited
oracle_text:
+1: You draw a card and you lose 1 life.
−3: Destroy target creature.
−8: Target opponent gets an emblem with "Whenever a player draws a card, you lose 2 life."
blocked_sentences: −8: Target opponent gets an emblem with "Whenever a player draws a card, you lose 2 life."

needs.what: an op that gives a chosen player (here a target opponent) an emblem -- a permanent command-zone object with no characteristics that cannot be removed and carries a written ability (here a triggered ability: event draw by any player, effect lose_life 2 for the emblem's OWNER, i.e. the targeted opponent, not the planeswalker's controller)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: No op in reference creates a command-zone object. grant_ability attaches an ability to battlefield objects and ends when they leave; delayed_trigger carries a duration and belongs to the ability's controller, so its 'you' would be Ob Nixilis's controller rather than the opponent who owns the emblem, and it would not survive as a permanent object. There is no emblem-owning player concept for 'you' to resolve against.
